'''Otal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Warrior]], who held the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Otal appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP gear vendor for the Sith Warrior class on Vaiken Spacedock, though she was later removed in a reorganization of the gear system.<ref name="TOR" />
